model_output.verdict: A product designer with concrete app work, but little about the decisions or results behind it.
write_up: I read this for Product Designer roles: your headline points there, and your Loop Fitness and Brightpath work back it up. It's common for design resumes to name the things built but leave out the decisions behind them. That makes it tough to stand out when other designers show both the work and what it changed.

The Loop Fitness design system line is a good model: it names what you created, a first for the app, and the tool you used. Your current cafe role accounts for your recent work; the resume doesn't show product design work since February 2024. Your portfolio link gives a recruiter somewhere to look, but the resume still needs to carry the story.
